title: Assemble runtime-aware initramfs and rootfs image path
purpose: Extend the boot/image pipeline so Alpha assembly includes runtime artifacts and not only the handoff stub.
scope: Integrate rootfs manifest validation with image or initramfs assembly.
Record runtime artifact hashes and image inputs.
Document any deliberate deferrals as blocking Alpha risks.
acceptance_criteria: Assembly fails when rootfs runtime manifest validation fails.
Assembly records runtime artifacts in a manifest.
Boot handoff path remains /sbin/agentd or an accepted equivalent.
Generated images and caches remain untracked.
verification: Inspect manifest for runtime artifact hashes.
risk_notes: Image factory work can hide missing runtime artifacts unless manifest validation is mandatory.
implementation_steps: Add the smallest runtime-aware assembly step compatible with current tooling.
Wire manifest validation before image promotion.
Run dependency and boot compatibility checks.
failure_modes: Assembly creates a bootable image without runtime policy/config/state.
Manifest records paths but not hashes.
Boot handoff is broken by path changes.

verification_matrix.expected: Fails closed on invalid manifest and emits manifest on success
QEMU and image dependencies are present
